name: BunnyBook Universal AI Entry
supported_hosts: any AI that can read a URL or pasted text

request_modes.label: 全盘规划
request_modes.purpose: 组织单元、项目或连续多课时的真实问题、共同成果、学科贡献、节点顺序与评价证据

request_modes.label: 学习进阶
request_modes.purpose: 追踪目标节点的必要前置、支持前置、掌握证据、补偿活动与后续解锁

request_modes.label: 单课时备课
request_modes.purpose: 生成可执行的一页蓝图、时间化流程、学生产物与形成性评价

request_modes.label: 教案核对
request_modes.purpose: 检查目标、进阶、活动、产物、证据、课标依据和时间的一致性

evidence_layers.description: 已依据本地语料核对的课标科目、核心素养名称、来源页码和版本信息
主题、节点、成员关系、hard/soft 前置和节点—课标对应；属于 author/inferred 项目设计，待学科教师复核
班情、课时、教材、本校要求、材料可得性和最终评价标准等需要教师决定的事项

fallback.when_web_access_is_unavailable: Ask the teacher to paste /llms-full.txt and explicitly state that the live graph was not read.

privacy.note: Do not request or process identifiable health, score, behavior, discipline, or opportunity data about individual students.

developer_enhancements.rule: All adapters must reuse the same canonical learning-map.json and trust policy.
